overview: The Medford Board of Health heard a biological agent permit presentation from MorphoCeuticals, received an update on a $72,000 youth gambling research grant, and reviewed recent seasonal vaccination efforts.

items.title: Approval of October 2024 Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes from the October 2024 meeting.

items.title: MorphoCeuticals Permit Application Presentation
items.summary: MorphoCeuticals presented an overview of its research facility and safety protocols for using regulated biological agents at 200 Boston Avenue, with permit issuance pending final application review.

items.title: Mass Gaming Commission Grant Award
items.summary: Health department staff announced a $72,000 grant from the Mass Gaming Commission to conduct a needs assessment on gambling impacts among 18- to 20-year-olds.

items.title: Flu and COVID-19 Vaccination Clinics Update
items.summary: Staff provided an update on completed fall vaccination clinics and noted ongoing vaccine delivery for homebound residents and young children.

items.title: Tabled Business: Nicotine Generation Regulation
items.summary: The board maintained tabled status on the proposed nicotine generation regulation to monitor actions in other communities and proposed state legislation.
